description: The pie chart, titled "Distribution of Different Categories," illustrates the proportion of various categories within a dataset, with each slice representing a distinct category and its corresponding percentage of the total. The largest segment, colored red, represents "Math" and accounts for 29.3% of the distribution, with a count of 410,756. The second largest segment, in blue, corresponds to "Coding" at 24.1% (339,907). The third largest, in light green, is "Information Seeking" at 22.2% (311,427). The "Reasoning" category, shown in orange, makes up 10.4% (145,329) of the total. Smaller segments include "Planning" at 2.3% (31,757), "Creative Writing" at 2.2% (30,144), and a combined "Others" category at 9.3% (130,671). The chart includes a legend on the left that lists all categories with their respective colors and counts, and the percentages are explicitly labeled on the chart for each slice. The segments are arranged in a clockwise direction, starting with the largest slice, "Math," and proceeding to the smaller ones.
